profile.summary: The Peria Karamalai Tea and Produce Company Limited produces and distributes tea in India. The company provides green tea, and orthodox and ctc black tea. It also offers coffee, black pepper, and spices, as well as fruits, such as avocados. In addition, the company is involved in the generation and distribution of power through solar and wind energy.
